name: Composio
summary: Composio is a developer platform that hosts MCP servers for over 1,500 toolkits. Google Search Console is one of them, with 9 tools.
signIn: OAuth through a Composio-managed Google app, or your own OAuth app. Developers create a session with the Composio SDK and an API key, which returns an MCP URL and headers.
tools: 9 tools, stated on the toolkit page.
dataSources: Google Search Console search analytics: clicks, impressions, CTR, position
Google Search Console sites and sitemaps
free: Hobby plan at $0, no credit card: 100,000 tool calls a month, of which up to 20,000 can run through Composio-managed apps such as Google Search Console. Usage pauses at the cap.
price: Hobby $0. Pro $29 per month with $29 usage credit, then $0.0003 per tool call ($0.0005 per tool call on Composio-managed apps). Enterprise custom. Prices in USD.
writeActions: Yes. Add Site, Delete Site and Submit Sitemap.
dataStorage: OAuth tokens and API keys are encrypted. Zero data retention of request and response payloads is a paid add-on on Pro for select features and included on Enterprise. Composio keeps execution logs.
pickIf: You are building your own agent and want Search Console next to Slack, Gmail or your CRM on one platform.
You want your agent to add and delete Search Console sites and submit sitemaps.
You need SOC 2 Type II compliance from the platform.

sources.fact: 9 tools, OAuth, clients, free tier wording, security
